## What changed

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the tests and focused checks performed.

## Documentation and release checklist

- [ ] README capabilities and explanations are current.
- [ ] Detailed architecture, operations, recovery, and limitation docs were updated where relevant.
- [ ] Exact Persian copy was updated where relevant.
- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior changes.
- [ ] New configuration names are included in `.env.example` without values.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private user records, or populated environment files are included.
- [ ] Planned features are not described as implemented.
- [ ] Deployment status and production verification are stated only if actually performed.
